goal: Move the remaining standard library families onto the standalone C runtime, including SQLite through a vendored amalgamation, so native runs no longer need a Python host for data work
new_in_2_9_10: the standalone runtime implements std.string, std.list, std.map, std.type, std.json, std.math, std.time, std.assert, and std.event in native C with no Python process; native lists and maps are value types, so the mutating helpers return new collections

std.game and the ai.* behaviour and decision helpers run natively: easing curves, tween, bounded grid neighbours, A* with Python heap tie-breaking, scene/entity/physics/anim, steering and perception, utility_choose, bt_tick, and fsm_tick

std.data reads JSONL and CSV streams in native C, and data_sqlite_open, data_sqlite_close, data_sqlite_query, and data_sqlite_execute run through the vendored SQLite 3.54.1 amalgamation in native/standalone/vendor/sqlite, which tests/language/test_source_structure.py excludes as generated third-party code

the CLI probe now sends --data-write runs to the standalone binary and forwards --data-write plus --data-max-rows, so native keeps the same write permission and row limit instead of falling back to the Python VM

std.ai.api_complete can POST to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with base_url, model, and an api_key or api_key_env; configuration reporters redact keys, and the client reuses the net_http_* sandbox rules
the standalone heap indexes tracked pointers so free-path lookup stops scanning the global block list; money and ledger loops no longer pay O(heap) per release

the CLI runtime command split into cli/commands/runtime_groups/, and the benchmark entry points, Cloudflare public-registry Worker, web, desktop, MMG, registry server, lint, AST, debugger, cbridge, agent control plane, agent registry, IR lowering, and compiler modules split behind imports-only facades
every native C source over 300 lines now includes contiguous *_partN.inc fragments, and a structure test pins numbering, include order, and the 300-line bound
runtime_notes: no opcode or bytecode layout changed in this patch

Python remains required for function-callback list helpers (list.map, list.filter, list.reduce, list.map_fn, list.filter_fn), the interop module, the encrypted save envelope, MELV standalone CLI hooks, debugger/events/record/replay, LSP, and package tooling
native collections are value types while the Python VM mutates them in place; parity tests pin the difference instead of hiding it
the standalone heap answers membership through a bucket index but still sweeps a linked list and has no automatic GC trigger
api_complete network transport is native for OpenAI-compatible providers; offline and local-rag providers remain byte-identical to the Python VM
runtime_policy: Native C is the release-authoritative runtime for v2.9.10 core work
default C execution must fail fast when native support is missing
release and CI validation should include native-only execution plus sanitizer/fuzzer gates
a new native family ships with a parity test that diffs its stdout against the Python VM
a file split must be verbatim and proven by before/after equivalence, not by review
